name: Mammalia
blurb: Animals that feed their young on milk and have hair and a jaw joint of their own. The platypus and echidna still lay eggs.

fossilMin.taxon: Ambondro mahabo (UA10602), an australosphenidan on the monotreme stem
fossilMin.dating: Top of the Bathonian, 166.1 ± 1.2 Ma, giving 164.9 Ma
fossilMin.checked: Benton et al. 2015, full text (palaeo-electronica.org/content/pdfs/424.pdf), node 57 (Crown Mammalia)

softMax.basis: Late Triassic and Early Jurassic mammaliaform faunas contain no member of either crown lineage: Triassic–Jurassic boundary, 201.3 ± 0.2 Ma
